seasonalNotes: Cold winters (−5°C Dec–Feb). Warm summers (25–35°C Jun–Aug). Rainy in spring/autumn. Shops closed Sundays. Christmas markets Nov–Dec.

personas.name: Berlin Freelancer Day
personas.tagline: Coworking, döner, and a Spree walk
personas.description: A freelancer in Kreuzberg: morning café work, coworking space, Markthalle lunch, DM pharmacy run, and evening along the Spree.

stops.title: Café work session — charge laptop
stops.description: Grab a seat with a plug at Five Elephant.
stops.action: Order a coffee and a healthy breakfast. Ensure your laptop and phone are fully charged.
stops.context: Five Elephant is popular with remote workers—arrive early for a good spot.
stops.wellbeing: Take a short break every hour to stretch and rest your eyes.
stops.motivation: A productive morning sets the tone for the day!
stops.localization: Staff speak English and German. Card payments accepted.
stops.transition: Prepare for your client call by reviewing notes.
stops.feedback: Did this café tip help you start your day well?

stops.title: Client call at 11 — find quiet spot
stops.description: Video call. Need stable WiFi and quiet room.
stops.action: Book a meeting room or use noise-canceling headphones.
stops.context: Coworking spaces can get noisy before lunch—reserve early if possible.
stops.wellbeing: Sit with good posture and keep water nearby.
stops.localization: Betahaus has phone booths for private calls.
stops.transition: After the call, update your project tracker.
stops.feedback: Was this call reminder useful for your workflow?

stops.title: Lunch at Markthalle Neun
stops.description: Thursday is Street Food Thursday. Arrive early to ensure availability.
stops.action: Try a new international dish or a local favorite. Bring cash for some vendors.
stops.context: Street Food Thursday draws crowds—arrive before noon for the best selection.
stops.wellbeing: Choose a balanced meal and stay hydrated.
stops.localization: Vegan and vegetarian options widely available.
stops.transition: Head to DM for your afternoon errands.
stops.feedback: Did you enjoy your lunch experience?

stops.title: DM run — shampoo + vitamins
stops.description: DM on Kottbusser Damm. Check Payback points.
stops.action: Check your shopping list and scan your Payback card at checkout.
stops.context: Afternoons are less crowded than evenings at DM.
stops.motivation: Small errands keep your week running smoothly!
stops.localization: Self-checkout available. Most staff speak English.
stops.transition: Plan your route for an evening walk.
stops.feedback: Did this DM reminder help you stay organized?

stops.title: Evening walk along the Spree
stops.description: Molecule Man to Oberbaumbrücke. Bring a jacket.
stops.action: Wear comfortable shoes and bring a light jacket, especially in spring/autumn.
stops.context: Sunset views are best from the bridge. Watch for cyclists on the path.
stops.wellbeing: Walking by the river is great for mental health.
stops.motivation: A peaceful walk helps you unwind after a busy day!
stops.localization: Nearby U-Bahn: Schlesisches Tor. Public toilets at the bridge.
stops.transition: Head home or meet friends for dinner nearby.
stops.feedback: Did this walk help you relax and recharge?

personas.name: Munich Weekend
personas.tagline: Marienplatz, beer garden, and English Garden
personas.description: A Saturday in Munich: Viktualienmarkt breakfast, Marienplatz, Pinakothek gallery, English Garden surfing, and a beer garden.

stops.title: Weißwurst breakfast at Viktualienmarkt
stops.description: Traditional: Weißwurst, Brezel, sweet mustard. Before 12 PM.
stops.action: Arrive before 11:30 AM for fresh Weißwurst. Bring cash for small vendors.
stops.context: Breakfast is a local tradition—expect crowds on weekends.
stops.wellbeing: Eat slowly and enjoy the atmosphere. Stay hydrated if it's hot.
stops.motivation: Start your day with a Bavarian classic!
stops.localization: Menus in German and English. Public toilets nearby.
stops.transition: Walk to Marienplatz for the Glockenspiel show.
stops.feedback: Did this breakfast tip help you enjoy Munich?

stops.title: Glockenspiel at Marienplatz
stops.description: Show at 11 AM and 12 PM. Get there 10 min early.
stops.action: Find a spot with a clear view of the tower. Have your camera ready.
stops.context: The Glockenspiel is a top tourist attraction—watch for pickpockets in crowds.
stops.wellbeing: Wear sunscreen if standing in the sun.
stops.transition: Head to Alte Pinakothek for art and culture.
stops.feedback: Did you enjoy the Glockenspiel show?

stops.title: Alte Pinakothek — €1 on Sundays
stops.description: Dürer, Rubens, da Vinci. Incredible collection.
stops.action: Buy your €1 ticket at the counter. Check for special exhibitions.
stops.context: Sundays are busy—arrive early for shorter lines.
stops.wellbeing: Museums are quiet spaces—speak softly and take breaks.
stops.localization: Audio guides available in multiple languages.
stops.transition: Walk or take the tram to the English Garden.
stops.feedback: Did this museum tip enhance your visit?

stops.title: Watch surfers at Eisbachwelle
stops.description: River surfers in the English Garden. Always a crowd.
stops.action: Find a safe spot to watch. Respect barriers and don’t block the path.
stops.context: Surfers are there year-round, but summer is busiest.
stops.wellbeing: Stay behind the railings for safety.
stops.motivation: See Munich’s adventurous spirit in action!
stops.localization: Nearest U-Bahn: Lehel. Food stalls nearby in summer.
stops.transition: Walk to the Chinesischer Turm for a beer garden experience.
stops.feedback: Did you enjoy watching the surfers?

stops.title: Beer garden — Chinesischer Turm
stops.action: Order a Maß (liter of beer) and try Obatzda with a pretzel. Bring cash.
stops.context: Beer gardens are self-service—return your glass for a deposit refund.
stops.wellbeing: Drink responsibly and eat before drinking.
stops.localization: Live music on weekends. Large tables for groups.
stops.transition: Plan your route back to the hotel or next destination.
stops.feedback: Did this beer garden tip help you enjoy Munich?
